posts.title: The Defence That Can't See the Attack
posts.dek: I built a prompt injection sandbox with no model in it. The most useful thing it does is show you a control failing for a reason that has nothing to do with how good the control is.

posts.title: Taxonomies That Outlive the Exploit
posts.dek: Every jailbreak list I bookmarked in 2024 is now useless. The categories underneath them are not. Sorting attacks by mechanism instead of by phrasing is the difference between a framework and a changelog.

posts.title: Detecting Prompt Injection: The Playbook Your SIEM Doesn't Have Yet
posts.dek: Prompt injection is succeeding in production right now, and most SOCs can't see it. Why traditional detection primitives partially-fail, three places where they can work, and what's still hard.

posts.title: The Bridge — Why AI Security Needs SOC People, and SOC Needs AI Red Teamers
posts.dek: Two communities that should be talking to each other are mostly not. Here's what each side is missing — and what bridging them looks like in practice.
